rounds.notes:
I think 11250 is perfectly reachable, this way you can change both [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) and [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) for their blue versions, [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054) and [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a).

Also keep [Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418), if you prefer it, its very helpful. And get [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) if money allows it.

Basically shoot harder, shoot faster and stay alive.

At this point you get [Reload Therapy](item_1d85105f-1ec7-4ec7-a56d-f273c09f4b3e) combine it with [Greased Loader](item_0ee48089-49a3-4980-a6f6-3d4b72585ead) to maximize your survivability and be less dependent on healers, how many times have you hid in a corner waiting for a healer? Wait no more, shoot at the floor and heal yourself! In an emergency i also tend to shoot and reload, i survived a brig ult by just running, shooting and reloading, needing to reload to survive takes a little getting used to, but with practice you will get there :D 

Ideally you should already have [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) and [Aftermarket Firing Pin](item_2485b212-b286-42d0-a2bd-20eb4396b054), these two are good to boost your DPS by both increasing raw damage and firing speed, i personally dislike just boosting one or the other, boosting both seems, to me at least, best.

As mentioned in the optional item [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b), If you money allows it, buy it. If selling [Talon Modification Module](item_c0ca1795-a3ea-4dc9-ae17-f34122574b3a) is what allows you to buy it, do it. Trust, shooting this hard this early in the game is gonna put you in an excellent position in the next few rounds.

[Heartbeat Sensor](item_2a4ffaf4-f14b-47d2-a267-0a0e83e87418) is a good item to have when you do a lot of dmg, keeping track of your objectives is great! But [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0) is just there to fill in the blanks, if i put something more expensive the round-to-round attainability goes off the window.

rounds.notes:
The powers, can diverge into two from here.

You can go [Early Detonation](item_9e8a8aad-96a1-4068-994c-be0d3750469b) first and then [Head Honcho](item_bbd85437-5add-424c-83e7-309a7ff7f447) or the other way around.
In S18 they got buffed [Early Detonation](item_9e8a8aad-96a1-4068-994c-be0d3750469b) reloads bullets, and those bullets now heal you when combined with [Reload Therapy](item_1d85105f-1ec7-4ec7-a56d-f273c09f4b3e).
And [Head Honcho](item_bbd85437-5add-424c-83e7-309a7ff7f447) now doesn't reset once you reload, allowing you to quickly shoot a few bullets, boost your first shot and really deal some damage to the enemies you actually want to kill.
You can go either of the two first, whichever you feel like needing.

Now about the items, if money allows it absolutely get [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce). 
If it doesn't allow it, then get [Aerial Distresser](item_0fcb9020-c729-49b9-b398-3223797b6204) if you need to pick off aerial targets like Mercy, Juno, Freya and maybe Genji.
Get [Codebreaker](item_caa96c7e-655f-4d03-9bd9-0f41937fec27) to do extra damage to heavy armored targets.
Get  [Salvaged Slugs](item_019d6c60-36eb-42ec-8d6e-5bbb44a0db61) if you want to break a Shield, sometimes it's quite useful to constantly leave them without their main source of cover.

I leave [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) in because... well it's better than an empty space but in case you really need survival and money allows it, then get [Crusader Hydraulics](item_b64cee07-ca32-405d-987e-868b415bbc09) or even [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) if you can afford it.

This survival items might be more important than [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce) depending on your situation.

At this point you should have enough  money to buy almost anything, but at the same time, you are here because the match is that even.

So we go with [The Closer](item_173c6d0f-dbe6-440e-924f-0ce08189ddce), [Eye of the Spider](item_bbaf01d7-340d-4199-b738-86a98d68fe9b) and [Booster Jets](item_a291de85-b6d9-43cf-b5da-f3184a156f48) for maximum DPS.

The more you are shooting the more damage you get to do, though this doesn't mean you shouldn't have target priority.

Lastly i like [Phantasmic Flux](item_5e644a79-cf6e-4196-8d0a-232f75004643) for survivability, its a goodie and gives you a lot of Lifesteal and a bit of AP and WP, if you need a bit more survivability, this might be it.

I put in [Codebreaker](item_caa96c7e-655f-4d03-9bd9-0f41937fec27) but it's not a must, it's just there for show, check the optionals, see what works for your situation best.
